reason: A hosted MCP service that supplies live crypto and stock market data, financial metrics, and recorded trading-signal information to compatible AI clients without executing trades.

summaries.zh: 通过 MCP 为兼容的 AI 客户端提供实时加密货币与股票市场数据、代币财务指标及历史信号统计。
summaries.en: Provides compatible AI clients with live cryptocurrency and stock market data, token financial metrics, and recorded signal statistics through MCP.

capabilities: Retrieves live cryptocurrency market-structure scores and signal levels
Provides meme-token filtering and recorded signal hit-rate statistics
Provides cryptocurrency token financial metrics and US stock snapshots
Connects to a hosted MCP endpoint and supports optional bearer authentication for Pro tools
